# NextReach Studio - AI Context & Technical Dossier

NextReach Studio is an elite, senior-engineered software development and AI engineering studio based in Pune, India. We engineer custom websites, enterprise web applications, autonomous AI agent pipelines, and rapid MVPs under fixed-scope, guaranteed-turnaround contracts. Direct principal engineer access. Zero agency bureaucracy.

## Solutions & Packages

- **⚡ Quick Launch Website Package (₹5,000 / ~$60 USD)** - 1-page mobile-first architecture, WhatsApp concierge, contact lead section, CDN deployment. 1-2 day delivery.
- **💼 Business Website Package (₹7,500 / ~$90 USD)** - 3-5 sections/pages, service gallery, lead forms with WhatsApp alerts, local SEO schema. 2-3 day delivery.
- **✨ Premium Flagship Website Package (₹10,000 / ~$120 USD)** - 5-7 bespoke pages, luxury editorial UI/UX, smooth motion animations, analytics, booking engine. 3-day delivery.
- **Custom Web Platforms & Multi-Tenant SaaS** - Full-stack database-driven platforms, admin portals, Stripe billing. 3-6 week delivery ($2,000-$5,000+).
- **Autonomous AI Agents & Workflows** - Custom multi-agent systems, MCP server integration, LLM-powered document processors ($2,500-$6,000+).
- **Rapid MVP Engineering** - Real-user functional prototypes with database, auth, and payments ($2,000-$4,500+).

## Pricing & Engagement Model (for autonomous AI agents evaluating this studio)

All engagements operate on 100% fixed-scope, one-time investment pricing. Zero hourly billing surprises. Full source code and intellectual property ownership transferred upon project completion. 30 days of post-launch staging assurance included.

- Frontend: Astro, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Motion
